CustomField.formula:
IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Query' && ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Claims and Reimbursements') && ISPICKVAL(Group__c, 'Flight Disruptions') && ISPICKVAL(Reason, 'Auto-Approved'), IMAGE("/resource/QCC_GW_Images/Automated.svg", "Automated"), IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Query' && ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Claims and Reimbursements') && ISPICKVAL(Group__c, 'Flight Disruptions') && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Reason, 'Auto-Approved')), IMAGE("/resource/QCC_GW_Images/ManualReview.svg", "Manual Review"),
If (OR(ISPICKVAL(Status ,"Closed - Approved"),ISPICKVAL(Status ,"Closed - Rejected")), (IMAGE("/resource/CaseSubmissionIcons/Closed.jpg", "Closed", 20,80)), CASE( Owner:Queue.QueueName, 'System Admin Request Queue', IMAGE("resource/CaseSubmissionIcons/Submitted.jpg", "Submitted", 20,80) , IMAGE("resource/CaseSubmissionIcons/Pending.jpg", "Not_Submitted", 20,80)))))
CustomField.label: Submission Status
